# Pointer Creek Wealth Management

> Pointer Creek Wealth Management is an independent, owner-led fiduciary planning and
> wealth management firm in Canfield, Ohio, serving individuals, families, business
> owners, trusts and other entities with financial lives that often extend well beyond
> an investment portfolio. Planning-first: understand the person, family or organization
> first; understand what the money needs to accomplish second; and only then determine
> what strategies, investments or other tools may be appropriate. Tagline: "See the
> unseen." Small by design — no quotas, no proprietary products. Managed-account minimum:
> $500,000+ in net investible assets; planning is scoped to complexity, not size.

Location: 201 South Broad Street, Canfield, Ohio 44406 · Phone: (234) 414-1014 · Email: team@pointercreek.com · Serves: Northeast Ohio (Mahoning Valley).

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.pointercreek.com/index.html): Who we are, the planning-first philosophy, and the three fiduciary service models.
- [About Pointer Creek](https://www.pointercreek.com/about.html): Our story ("Built to Practice Financial Advice Differently"), the "see the unseen" philosophy, what we believe, and the team.
- [Who We Serve](https://www.pointercreek.com/who-we-serve.html): Ideal clients, the $500,000+ minimum, the mindsets and change situations we serve best, and where we're not a fit.
- [Our Process — How We Actually Work](https://www.pointercreek.com/how-we-work.html): From first conversation and mutual-fit meeting to a thorough, CFP®-led planning process, documentation, and long-term partnership; no AUM quotas or hidden agenda.
- [Fiduciary Services](https://www.pointercreek.com/services.html): The three fiduciary service models, how they combine, Integrated Relationship Pricing, and how each service is priced.
  - [Fiduciary Planning Projects](https://www.pointercreek.com/service-planning-projects.html): A defined-scope planning project — one decision or a full financial, tax, retirement and estate-planning architecture, with a defined beginning, scope and conclusion.
  - [Ongoing Fiduciary Planning](https://www.pointercreek.com/service-ongoing-planning.html): Pointer Creek keeps the planning process alive on a defined calendar, including Family & Private Enterprise Advisory Services (and, for a very limited number of families, a fractional family office relationship).
  - [Ongoing Fiduciary Wealth Management](https://www.pointercreek.com/service-ongoing-wealth.html): Portfolio construction, monitoring, rebalancing and tax-aware implementation according to the plan, including thoughtful transition of existing portfolios.
- [Fees & Transparency](https://www.pointercreek.com/fees-transparency.html): How we're compensated (fiduciary asset management and financial planning), why we publish fees, and why we're not a pure-AUM firm.
- [Investment Philosophy](https://www.pointercreek.com/investment-philosophy.html): Planning before investing, why we don't chase hot tips, risk capacity vs. tolerance vs. appetite, activity is not progress, and thoughtful transition of existing portfolios.
- [FAQ](https://www.pointercreek.com/faq.html): Plain answers on minimums, fiduciary status, privacy, timelines, and first meetings.
- [Contact](https://www.pointercreek.com/contact.html): Request an introductory meeting — no pitch, no product, no obligation.

## Related service topics
- [Fee-Based Financial Planning](https://www.pointercreek.com/fee-based-planning.html): Major financial decisions planned before they become expensive mistakes — personal/family and business planning.
- [Trust & Estate Planning](https://www.pointercreek.com/trust-estate-planning.html): Wills, trusts, powers of attorney, beneficiary reviews, trust funding, and implementation follow-through. We coordinate with your attorney; we do not draft legal documents.
- [Fiduciary Wealth Management](https://www.pointercreek.com/wealth-management.html): Low-fee strategies built on academic research; ETFs, index and institutional funds, individual securities, and private placements for accredited investors.
- [Fiduciary Risk Management](https://www.pointercreek.com/risk-management.html): What would actually happen to cash flow, the business, and the surviving spouse. Fixed insurance through B Renner LLC.

## Compliance
Securities offered through Cambridge Investment Research, Inc., a broker-dealer, member FINRA/SIPC. Investment advisory services offered through Cambridge Investment Research Advisors, Inc., a Registered Investment Advisor. Fixed insurance services offered through B Renner LLC, an unaffiliated Ohio insurance agency. Cambridge does not offer tax or legal advice.
